create_dit_model: create a DiT model with configurable depth, heads, and text embedding for audio generation
build_text_embedding: build a TextEmbedding module with positional encoding and optional ConvNeXtV2 blocks for text processing
configure_cfg_inference: configure DiT for classifier-free guidance inference by packing conditional and unconditional branches
cache_text_embeddings: cache text conditional and unconditional embeddings in DiT for repeated inference without recomputation
apply_input_embedding: apply InputEmbedding to combine noised audio, conditioning audio, and text embeddings with position encoding
